name: Slivers
description: Hive-minded creatures that share abilities with nearby slivers, originating on an unknown plane and spread through the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Hanna and Mirri face slivers that protect each other.
timeline.quote: We must learn how they protect each other.

citation.text: Armor Sliver (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The swarm ignores the destruction of the artificial slivers.
timeline.quote: They clearly were not the leaders," Hanna cursed.

citation.text: Disenchant (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard orders slivers kept at sword's length, but their talons grow longer.
timeline.quote: Keep them at sword's length!

citation.text: Talon Sliver (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barbed slivers form a deadly hedge around the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: forming a deadly hedge around the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Barbed Sliver (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A counterfeit accepted by the sliver hive increases Volrath's influence.
timeline.quote: Volrath's influence upon the slivers grew even stronger.

citation.text: Metallic Sliver (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath takes a number of the Sliver Queen's brood away to study them in the Furnace of Rath.
timeline.quote: He then took a number of her brood away from her (and stuck them in the Furnace of Rath ) so he could study them.

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath uses the hive to guard the Legacy and attack the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: Volrath used the hive to guard the Legacy and to attack Weatherlight and her crew on their quest to retake those artifacts and their captain, Sisay .

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slivers burst into the Weatherlight in the Furnace of Rath.
timeline.quote: the slivers burst through the walls of the cave to attack the Weatherlight

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Rathi Overlay slivers are transported to Urborg, most dying and the rest killed in the Invasion.
timeline.quote: During the Rathi Overlay the slivers were transported to Urborg .

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rathi Overlay". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The first sliver slips out of Riptide in the form of a junior researcher.
timeline.quote: Taking the form of a junior researcher, the first sliver slipped out of Riptide.

citation.text: Mistform Sliver (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The slivers break free of the Riptide Project and adapt to life on Otaria.
timeline.quote: After breaking free from the Riptide Project, the slivers quickly adapted to life on Otaria

citation.text: Blade Sliver (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Riptide Project loses control of its last slivers and the island is overrun.
timeline.quote: there was nothing to keep the island from being completely overrun.

citation.text: Shifting Sliver (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: More slivers nest in Otaria within weeks than ever existed on Rath.
timeline.quote: Within weeks, more slivers nested in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.

citation.text: Brood Sliver (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Slivers are reintroduced as clones of the originals through the Riptide Project.
timeline.quote: have been reintroduced as clones of the original slivers as part of the Riptide Project

citation.text: "Legions", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A rift opens, and a Benalish patrol sees Thed killed by a sliver while arrows hang still.
timeline.quote: A rift opened, and our arrows were abruptly stilled.

citation.text: Fury Sliver (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Venser builds a sliver prototype intended to obey him.
timeline.quote: Venser admired his handiwork and smiled.

citation.text: Venser's Sliver (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Freyalise considers giving a sliver breed a new master.
timeline.quote: It seeks a new master. Perhaps I can give it one.

citation.text: Ghostflame Sliver (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Riptide Project wizards revive slivers without recreating the Sliver Queen, and the slivers go rampant.
timeline.quote: Without her, the slivers went rampant, proving impossible to tame and breeding out of control.

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Riptide Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Most slivers die in the explosion that created Karona; a small group fuses into the Sliver Overlord.
timeline.quote: However, a small group of slivers survived and fused into the ultimate manifestation of the hive mind, the Sliver Overlord .

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Riptide Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weaver King takes control of slivers to wage war on their former masters.
timeline.quote: Once the Weaver King discovered the simplicity of their hivemind, he quickly took control of them for his purposes and used them to wage war on their former masters.

citation.text: "Sliver", section "After the apocalypse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On an unknown plane the Gravemother's brood razes kingdoms in a single night.
timeline.quote: In a single night, kingdoms were reduced to rubble as their former servants were joined by the Gravemother's hardened brood.

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Unknown plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hanna sees unsettling unanimity among slivers and urges Sisay to keep the ship at a distance.
timeline.quote: she urged Sisay to keep the ship at a safe distance.

citation.text: Sinew Sliver (Planar Chaos, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In Skyshroud Freyalise uses the slivers' hive mind to beat back the Phyrexians and asks Jhoira to find Radha.
timeline.quote: She requests that Jhoira find Radha in the Pardic mountains

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A clever counterfeit is accepted by the sliver hive, strengthening Volrath's influence upon the slivers.
timeline.quote: When the clever counterfeit was accepted by the hive, Volrath's influence upon the slivers grew even stronger.

citation.text: Metallic Sliver (Premium Deck Series: Slivers, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard looks for the source of a mysterious pulse and slivers boil forth from the crevasses.
timeline.quote: at that moment the slivers boiled forth from the crevasses.

citation.text: Heart Sliver (Premium Deck Series: Slivers, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Riptide Project's directors want instant results from sliver experiments and get them.
timeline.quote: They got their wish.

citation.text: Quick Sliver (Premium Deck Series: Slivers, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Spines of slivers leap between them, forming a hedge around the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: forming a deadly hedge around the

citation.text: Barbed Sliver (Premium Deck Series: Slivers, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Slivers, long after Volrath's death, become what he wanted: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.
timeline.quote: Though Volrath is long dead

citation.text: Necrotic Sliver (Premium Deck Series: Slivers, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Llanach describes a colossal sliver rumbling over a ridge as the slivers they fought surged and howled.
timeline.quote: we knew it was time to flee.

citation.text: Might Sliver (Premium Deck Series: Slivers, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Outside the city, Yisan reads the stolen book, the journal of the Thunian scout Hastric, revealing a sliver hive with abandoned treasure; Jalira decides to go.
timeline.quote: But contained within the notes were reports of dead merchants and travelers in the deepest parts of the sliver network

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: They find the sliver cave and Jalira, over Yisan's objections, uses blue smoke on them.
timeline.quote: Blue smoke began to flow from Jalira's fingertips.

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Jalira and Yisan, transformed into slivers, fight to keep their minds against the hive's hum and will of the hivelord.
timeline.quote: They lose each other, forgetting who they are.

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: They reach the central chamber where the hivelord drops their sliver forms, and, naked, take clothing and treasure while the hivelord does nothing.
timeline.quote: slowly procured as many coins and treasures as they and their pilfered clothes could carry

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Yisan decides to stay and study the slivers' music while Jalira takes the treasure to Martyne.
timeline.quote: I think I'm going to stay here for a while,

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Sliver spines form a deadly hedge around the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Spans of spines leapt from one sliver to the next, forming a deadly hedge around the Weatherlight.

citation.text: Barbed Sliver (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: While scouting near the Eastern Sea, Hastric is struck by a rockfall and tumbles into the sliver caves of the Skep, where he is transformed into a sliver.
timeline.quote: Hastric found himself transformed into a sliver himself.

citation.text: "Hastric", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hastric discovers that huge sliver leaders command the others, mimics the slivers to avoid notice, and finds a dragon-sized fossilized sliver and worshipped humanoid slivers.
timeline.quote: He discovered one fossilized sliver that was the size of a dragon

citation.text: "Hastric", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hastric slowly backs away into a tunnel and finds evidence in a seaside cave that the slivers once had very different shapes.
timeline.quote: Hastric kept pretending to follow their swaying and writhing motions

citation.text: "Hastric", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pursued by spiny slivers, Hastric changes into an aquatic sliver, escapes through the ocean and reverts to human form.
timeline.quote: managed to change into an aquatic form of sliver and escape their caves through the ocean itself

citation.text: "Hastric", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yisan and Jalira investigate the Skep after hearing Hastric and are transformed into slivers by the sliver leaders.
timeline.quote: themselves transforming into slivers by the power of the sliver leaders

citation.text: "Hastric", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Riptide Project runs out of control as reborn Slivers kill its mages and reach the mainland.
timeline.quote: Llawan's fate after this is unknown.

citation.text: "Llawan", section "Reign". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Project's wizards revive a dead sliver and breed new types with new powers.
timeline.quote: the Project’s wizards revived it, breeding new types with new powers

citation.text: "Riptide Island", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The slivers, with no queen to control them, swarm Riptide Island and kill most of the researchers; survivors such as Pemmin flee.
timeline.quote: the slivers eventually swarmed all over Riptide Island, killing most of the researchers

citation.text: "Riptide Island", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A sliver in the form of a junior researcher slips out of Riptide and the slivers spread across mainland Otaria.
timeline.quote: Taking the form of a junior researcher, the first sliver slipped out of Riptide.

citation.text: "Riptide Island", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The project recreated slivers, which without the Sliver Queen ran wild, slaughtered most researchers and spread over Dominaria.
timeline.quote: the slivers ran wild and slaughtered most of the researchers

citation.text: "Riptide Project", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pemmin was the only known researcher to survive.
timeline.quote: there was only one researcher known to have survived the Slivers' devastating onslaught

citation.text: "Riptide Project", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The inhabitants of Shandalar must combat the growing hive mind of the slivers, which threatens to consume their world.
timeline.quote: Now the inhabitants of this unusual plane must combat the growing hive mind of the slivers

citation.text: "Shandalar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: once controlled by Rath's evincars, now makes slaves not masters
relations.quote: Rath's evincars used hivestones to control the slivers

citation.text: Hivestone (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: Their appendages are sharper than our swords and quicker than our bows.

citation.text: Bonescythe Sliver (Magic 2014, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: discovered and described the slivers in detail
relations.quote: is famous for having discovered and described the Shandalaran slivers in great detail

citation.text: "Hastric". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: the Project’s wizards revived it, breeding new types with new powers

citation.text: "Riptide Island", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: A sliver queen who completed their ultimate evolution.
relations.quote: this queen, the Gravemother , finally completed the ultimate evolution: to conquer death.

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Unknown plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
